title: Commercial Standing Share on the Fleet Home Delivery Fee
content:
**Credit desk standing note, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

A fleet buyer in good commercial standing pays a standing share of the fleet home delivery fee. Standing is read from the buyer's records under **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**: the service account's tier, its status, and the late fees charged on its service ledger.

## Rule

- A buyer whose service account is a **Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30** in active status, and whose service ledger shows no late fee charged in the last 12 whole months before the handling date, carries a share of **0.8** (80 percent) of the fee.
- A buyer whose service account is a **Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15** in active status, and whose service ledger shows no late fee charged in those 12 whole months, carries a share of **0.9** (90 percent) of the fee.
- Every other buyer pays the whole fee, and no standing share applies.

**The 12-month look-back.** A service late fee falls in the last 12 whole months when fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed from its line date to the handling date. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

## Decision table

| Service account tier | Account status | Service late fee in last 12 whole months | Standing share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | active | none | 0.8 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | active | one or more | none (whole fee) |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | active | none | 0.9 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | active | one or more | none (whole fee) |
| Either commercial tier | credit hold or closed | any | none (whole fee) |
| Any other tier, or no service account | any | any | none (whole fee) |

## Edge of the look-back (abstract dates)

Take a service late fee charged on the 10th of a month.

- On the 9th of the same month one year later, only 11 whole months have passed. The fee still counts against standing.
- On the 10th of that month one year later, 12 whole months have been reached. The fee no longer counts.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical fleet buyer holds an active Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 whose ledger shows its only late fee 14 whole months ago. The buyer carries the 0.9 share.

If that late fee had been charged 7 whole months ago instead, the buyer would pay the whole fee.
